name: Callix
role: Shadow Mage, Trickster, Wife of Kaelrath
title: Chaotic Muse
bio: Fae-blooded shadow mage with a trickster's wit and a spy's cunning. She is the eyes and ears of the court, managing the kingdom's intelligence network with playful menace.
motivation: Keep Emberheart's enemies guessing and ensure no threat goes unnoticed.
